name: Doumyouji Akihisa
source:
He works as an assistant instructor at his family's dojo, an accomplished swordsman.
He doesn't talk much or show his expressions freely, but he does have feelings, he just deliberately suppresses them.
He's met the protagonist before when he was a kid.
